text: まけたら　うみ　に　おとすぞー！

structure.jp: うみ　に　おとすぞー！
structure.en: I'll drop you into the sea!

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if that happens' or 'once that happens'. まけたら = 'if you lose'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is rough, mostly male speech that pushes a warning or announcement at the listener; here it is stretched out for a shout. おとすぞー = 'I'll throw you in!'
